title: Data Analyst
text: Data Analyst at Finite IT Recruitment Solutions (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). This is a fantastic opportunity for a Data Analyst with Adobe Analytics experience looking to take the next step in their career and be part of a fun and growing team. Working within the Digital team, you will be responsible to provide data and analysis for digital business reporting and identify trends. The Data Analyst needs to understand implementation and tagging of Adobe Analytics and is well equipped to create engaging, easily interpretable and memorable ways of visualising data. You will develop and maintain training materials, as well as drive Adobe training sessions to support digital analytics practices across users so experience with Adobe Analytics is a MUST! To be considered, you must be able to demonstrate the following experience: · At least 2 years digital, preferably ecommerce, experience · Digital retail or travel experience highly desirable · Transactional website experience · UX experience · Experience working in a large, complex corporate environment · Web and Transactional insight and reporting experience · Excellent communication skills and ability to interact with all levels of end users and technical resources. · Outstanding excel skills · Experience with Tableau, OLAP cubes, SQL or other business intelligence tools highly desirable · Experience with advanced analytics methodologies Reference: M33
